name: Doppler effect, the apparent frequency
description: Calculates apparent frequency where f_o is frequency heard by the observer, f_s is frequency produced by the source, v is speed of sound in the medium, v_o is speed of the observer, and v_s is speed of the source.

name: Intensity of Sound
description: The intensity of the sound at a place is the energy transmitted per second per unit area held normally to direction of sound, where ρ = density of medium, v = velocity of sound wave, ω = angular frequency of sound wave, and A = amplitude of sound wave.

name: Intensity of a wave
description: The intensity of a wave is directly proportional to the square of the amplitude of the wave.
